text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after one of the remaining monsters,
the trio arrive at a village near Elizabeth Park.
text_block_list.orig_text:
図鑑から現れた魔物を追う{0}たちは、
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】近くの村へと辿り着いた。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……すやすや……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for having you carry her, {0}.
The last monster I faced likely came this way, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみません{0}さん。
お姉ちゃんをおぶっていただいて……
魔物が逃げたのは、
おそらくこの辺りだと思うんですが……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Something seems... off? This village is usually so lively,
but I can't see or sense anyone around. The doors are
all locked, too. Don't tell me the monster already—
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいですね……
どの家も扉が閉まっていて、
人の気配がありません。
いつもなら賑やかな村なのに……
もしかして、
魔物がみんなを……

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: H-hey. Is someone out there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おい、
誰かいるのか？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
That sounded like it came from inside...
Umm, we're not here to cause any harm.
Do you mind explaining what's going on here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
声？　
家の中から？
あの、
怪しい者ではありません、
お話しを聞かせてはもらえませんか？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Ohh, you're one of the girls from Elizabeth Park.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお……
あんたはたしか、
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】んとこの……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I am, yes. What exactly happened here?
It's awfully quiet, plus I can't see anyone else around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
一体なにがあったんですか？
妙に静かですし、
他の方々は。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else is hiding out in their homes.
I'm not sure why, but a monster managed to get through
the anti-monster barrier we have here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
村のみんなは家の中で隠れてんだ……
どういうわけか、
魔物除けの結界があるはずなのに魔物が現れてな……
困ってんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
A monster that can bypass that type of barrier... That has to be it.
They're nothing like regular monsters, after all.
choice_data_list: We should hurry and seal it.
We need to help them out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物除けが効かない……
おそらく図鑑の魔物ですね。
彼らはイレギュラーな存在ですし……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. It's my fault that this happened in the first place,
so I have a responsibility to bring it to an end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
この村の人々を不安にしてしまった要因は、
私にありますから……
責任を果たします。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'm the one who undid the seal,
so I have every intention of making up for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろんです……
私が封印を解いてしまった……
自分が起こした事態は自分で収拾をつけます。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Please stick with me for just a bit longer, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん。もう少しだけ、
力を貸してください。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
You guys should get outta here.
That thing could come back any time now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたらもとっとと逃げた方がいいぜ……
いつ奴らが戻ってくるか……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely what we're hoping for.
You, however, should stay inside.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは家の中に避難していてください。
魔物は私たちがなんとかします。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: F-for real...? Don't go doing anything too wild now, you hear?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、マジかよ……
あ、あんまり無茶はすんじゃねえぞ？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Something's still off... The air is far too still
in spite of a monster like that lurking nearby.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なぜでしょう
……魔物がいるにしては、静かすぎます……
気配も、
音もない……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: I can't even trace it with my heightened senses, either...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の……
獣人族の感覚でも
気配が読めないなんて……

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
A surprise attack right now would prove deadly...
I need to find it quick, lest anything should happen to Hatsune and {0}...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今不意打ちを受けたら、
間違いなくやられる……
なんとか、
お姉ちゃんと{0}さんだけでも守らないと。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: If it's going to attack, then where is it likely to come from?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこから来る？　
どこから……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: すや……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wah! 
Shiorin, above you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！
シオリン上っ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Above?! Gurgh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
上！？　
くっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: GGGHHKKKKKSSS!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect it to be concealing itself among the rooftops.
That could have been awful if you hadn't noticed...
text_block_list.orig_text:
屋根の上で気配を消して潜んでたんですね……
お姉ちゃんが教えてくれなかったら今頃は……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. No way I could stay asleep when you're in danger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへー、
シオリンのピンチだもん！　
目も覚めちゃうよ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
We can seal it away now that it's shown itself, though.
I have my arrows and bookmark at the ready!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、お姉ちゃん。
矢にブックマークをセットして……
いきます！

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: GGGRRRRGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: I-it's too fast! I can't take proper aim at a target like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
速い！　
これじゃあ、狙いが定まらない！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Hatsune, {0}! Take cover inside one of the buildings!
It'll pick us off one by one if we stay together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん、{0}さん！　
建物の陰に隠れて！
固まっていたら全員やられちゃう！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Wait up, Shiorin!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
シオリン！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Did it go back up on the rooftops?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物は……
また屋根の上？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
It's predicting how I'll act based on my line of sight and
body language. All while exerting a terrifying amount of
pressure, too... The second I let my guard down, it's over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの魔物、
私の視線や体捌きから動きを読んでる……
それにこの威圧感……
構えを解いたらすぐにやられる──！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... So [i]that's[/i] why it can predict her actions.
Yeah. I can generally tell what Shiorin's thinking.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか……
だからシオリンの動きも読まれちゃうんだ……
うん、
シオリンの考えてることがね、
わかるんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Chances are that monster has a really sensitive sense of sight and smell! Oh man, what should I do?! Shiorin's in real trouble now!
choice_data_list: How about throwing it off using magic?
text_block_list.orig_text:
たぶんすごく目と耳が敏感なんだよあの魔物！
どうしよう！　
このままじゃシオリンがやられちゃうかも！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Magic doesn't work on that thing though, right?
Hmm? Ohh! Good call!
That's a surefire way to help her out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもあの魔物に魔法は効かないんじゃ……
ふむふむ……
そっかぁ！　
流石{0}くん！
その作戦ならシオリンをアシストできるね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Righty-o!
I'm at full power again after that nap on your back,
so let's do this!
choice_data_list: How're you gonna relay the plan to her?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし！　
{0}くんの背中で寝たから
元気もいっぱいだし！　
がんばっちゃうよー！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Wa-ha-ha! Don't forget, my friend.
Words aren't necessary between the two of us! Sha-shing! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっふっふー！　
さっきの見てたでしょ？
私とシオリンに言葉はいらないのだ！　
きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Get ready, my dude. 'Cause I'm going all out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあいくよ？　
ハツネちゃんの全力！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
This isn't good.
The longer this drags on, the more exhausted I'm going to ge—
text_block_list.orig_text:
このまま神経をすり減らし続けても、
疲弊してそこを狙われるだけ……
どうすれば──

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Shiorin! Shut your eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリン！　
目を瞑って！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Hatsune? Oh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃん……
はっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: GGGRRRUOOHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
That's her magic!
She used it to dull the monster's senses!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんの魔法！　
そっか、
これで魔物の目と耳を！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Won't do much damage-wise, but now it can't predict her movements! Get ready, Shiorin! It's gonna charge right at you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
攻撃は効かないけど、
これでシオリンの動きは読めない！
シオリン！　
魔物が突っ込んでくるよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: GGGRRRUOOHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: She made the perfect opening for me. I won't let it go to waste!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんが作ってくれた好機、
無駄にはしない……！

text_block_list.name: Monster 1
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: We did it! That bad boy's sealed away for good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！　
封印成功だよー！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Mmghh... I-I felt like you were talking to me from afar,
so it's all thanks to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
むぎゅ……
お、
お姉ちゃんのおかげだよ……
お姉ちゃんの声が聞こえた気がして……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Nothing can trump our beautiful bonds!
Wow, though. That thing sure was strong.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへー、
私たちの絆は最強なのだー！
それにしても強い魔物だったねー

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Let's see what the book had to say about it...
Hm... It boasts an incredible sense of sight, hearing, and smell...
text_block_list.orig_text:
図鑑にはなんて書いてあるのかな……
えっと……
優れた視覚、
聴覚、
嗅覚を持ち……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Smell as well? Th-that sure was a close one, haha...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
鼻も利くんだ……
あ、
危なかったね！　
あははは……！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
That leaves just one monster to be sealed.
The Ziz, I believe? We should stay on gua—
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで残る魔物はあと一匹……
お姉ちゃんが見たジズだけ……
最後まで油断は禁物──

text_block_list.name: Ziz
text_block_list.text: KKKKRRRSSSKKKRR!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There it is!
And it's got its eyes on the book!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
ジズ！　
あの眼……
図鑑を狙ってるんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Shiorin, {0}! You two okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シオリン、{0}くん、
大丈夫！？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
We're both fine, yes.
Fighting that thing here is just going to
cause unnecessary damage to the village, though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
{0}さんも無事……
けど、
これ以上ここで戦ったら村に被害がでちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text:
Then let's lure it away!
Come on, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ジズを村の外におびき出してそこで戦おうよ！
行こう、
二人とも！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The trio promptly fled the village as the Ziz made chase,
its thunderous cry echoing through the sky.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怒号響かせ３人に迫るジズ。
村への被害を最小限に抑えるため、
その場を後にする{0}たちであった。
